author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance artists for character design and illustration
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios is opening opportunities for freelance artists to collaborate on various upcoming projects. Looking for artists skilled in: Character Design & Illustration, Character Sprites, Background & Environment Art, Webtoon / Comic Artwork, Game & Digital Art Assets, and other illustrations and visual development. Qualifications include strong portfolio, ability to follow art direction, good anatomy/composition/color, meet deadlines, accept feedback. How to apply: Send portfolio and brief introduction to avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com with subject Freelance Artist Application – [Your Name]. Include artwork types, art style, availability, freelance rate.
